reasons.invite_limit: This person got 5 invitations today. Try again tomorrow.
reasons.invite_agent: An agent gets no invitation. It signs in through its person.

invite.subject: Your invitation to Madar
invite.title: Welcome to Madar, {{name}}
invite.body: Your office invites you to Madar. Open the link to set your password.
invite.note: The link works one time, for 1 hour. If it ended, open it anyway and press "Send me a new link".

reset.subject: Reset your Madar password
reset.title: Hello {{name}}
reset.body: Open the link to set a new password.
reset.note: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email. Your password stays the same.

emailChanged.subject: Your Madar sign-in email changed
emailChanged.title: Hello {{name}}
emailChanged.body: Your Madar sign-in email is now {{email}}. Mail from Madar goes to that address from now on.
emailChanged.note: If you did not expect this change, tell the Admin of your office at once.
